title: ComfortLease Equipment Leases: Cancellation Before Installation — Training Notes
content:
**The rule.** A ComfortLease Equipment Leases agreement cancelled before installation is terminated with the system's cancellation-before-installation fee, and a fee of $0.00 means no fee. A lease is cancelled before installation when the lessee confirms the cancellation while the lease is still pending installation.

| Leased system | Fee to cancel before installation |
|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | $0.00 — no fee |
| ComfortLease Central Air | $0.00 — no fee |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | $0.00 — no fee |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | $0.00 — no fee |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | $0.00 — no fee |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | $0.00 — no fee |

## Questions answered

**Which leases does this rule speak to?**
Leases still pending installation — signed, but with the equipment not yet installed and rent not yet begun.

**Who brings the cancellation about?**
The lessee, by confirming the cancellation.

**What status does the lease take?**
Terminated.

**What does the lessee pay to cancel?**
Nothing. The fee is $0.00 on all six systems, and $0.00 means no fee.

**Does a fee apply to a ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone lease, the system with the highest installation fee?**
No. The cancellation-before-installation fee is $0.00 on that system as on every other.
